map.气压高度=真实海拔吗？: Does pressure altitude equal the true altitude?
map.仅标准大气下近似相等；真实大气冷暖偏差会使密度高度偏离几何高度，影响飞行。: They are approximately equal only under the standard atmosphere; warm/cold deviations in the real atmosphere make the density altitude deviate from the geometric altitude, affecting flight.
map.为什么越高气压越低？: Why does pressure decrease with height?
map.空气柱重量随高度减少，气压按指数衰减，每升约 5500 m 减半。: The weight of the air column decreases with height, so pressure decays exponentially, halving about every 5500 m.
